_about: Lync protocol v3 (PROTOCOL.md): Noise_IK_25519_ChaChaPoly_SHA256 with fixed keys. Private keys: phone static 32x0x11, phone ephemeral 32x0x22, Mac static 32x0x33, Mac ephemeral 32x0x44. TCP: phone initiates, prologue lync-tcp-v3, payloads {"name":"Pixel","app":"1.0.0"} and {"name":"MacBook","app":"1.0.0","paired":true}. BLE: Mac initiates, prologue lync-ble-v3, empty payloads. *_ready_*: the first sealed ready message after the handshake. Checked by mac/scripts/crypto-check.sh and the Android NoiseTest.
